card.name: Medical nouns inside warning headings
card.fires_on: Mostly the 'urb' in 'Disturbance(s)' in warning headings such as 'Visual Disturbances', and 'of' after 'suppression'. Also scattered medical nouns like 'inflammation' in symptom lists.

modes.label: Suppression of
modes.description: The word 'of' right after 'suppression' naming a body function or hormone.
modes.example: Melphalan causes suppression<< of>> ovarian function in premenopausal women

modes.label: Symptom list nouns
modes.description: A medical noun ending a list of symptoms.
modes.example: Acute injuries are generally characterized by redness, swelling,<< inflammation>> and sharp pain.
